title: Clioquinol rescues yeast cells from Abeta42 toxicity via the inhibition of oxidative damage.
authors: Zheng, Qiaoqiao; Zhu, Hongzheng; Lv, Chunyi; Zhu, Ziting; Cui, Hanyue; Fan, Zheyu; Sun, Jing; Huang, Zhiwei; Shi, Ping
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Clioquinol对酵母细胞中Abeta42毒性的抗氧化保护机制，涉及分子对接但对象为小分子-酶互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD), the most common form of dementia, has gotten considerable attention. Previous studies have demonstrated that clioquinol (CQ) as a metal chelator is a potential drug for the treatment of AD. However, the mode of action of CQ in AD is still unclear. In our study, the antioxidant effects of CQ on yeast cells expressing Abeta42 were investigated. We found that CQ could reduce Abeta42 toxicity by alleviating reactive oxygen species (ROS) generation and lipid peroxidation level in yeast cells. These alterations were mainly attributable to the increased reduced glutathione (GSH) content and independent of activities of superoxide dismutase (SOD) and/or catalase (CAT). CQ could affect antioxidant enzyme activity by altering the transcription level of related genes. Interestingly, it was noted for the first time that CQ could combine with antioxidant enzymes to reduce their enzymatic activities by molecular docking and circular dichroism spectroscopy. In addition, CQ restored Abeta42-mediated disruption of GSH homeostasis via regulating YAP1 expression to protect cells against oxidative stress. Our findings not only improve the current understanding of the mechanism of CQ as a potential drug for AD treatment but also provide ideas for subsequent drug research and development.
abstract_zh: 阿尔茨海默病（Alzheimer's disease, AD）作为最常见的痴呆形式，已受到广泛关注。既往研究表明，氯碘羟喹（clioquinol, CQ）作为一种金属螯合剂，是治疗AD的潜在药物。然而，CQ在AD中的作用机制仍不明确。在本研究中，我们探讨了CQ对表达Abeta42的酵母细胞的抗氧化效应。研究发现，CQ能通过减轻酵母细胞中活性氧（reactive oxygen species, ROS）的产生和脂质过氧化水平来降低Abeta42的毒性。这些变化主要归因于还原型谷胱甘肽（reduced glutathione, GSH）含量的增加，且与超氧化物歧化酶（superoxide dismutase, SOD）和/或过氧化氢酶（catalase, CAT）的活性无关。CQ可通过改变相关基因的转录水平来影响抗氧化酶活性。有趣的是，我们首次通过分子对接和圆二色谱光谱发现，CQ能与抗氧化酶结合，降低其酶活性。此外，CQ通过调控YAP1表达，恢复了Abeta42介导的GSH稳态失衡，从而保护细胞免受氧化应激损伤。我们的发现不仅增进了对CQ作为AD潜在治疗药物机制的理解，也为后续药物研发提供了思路。
